# Devoto

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Supermarket chain in Uruguay with an online store. Sells groceries, beverages, household and personal care, appliances, technology and toys. Online orders deliver within the store's published delivery zones; the homepage refers prices to the delivery area without naming it.
